sentences.en: The two felt the pressing necessity of earning a livelihood.
sentences.zh: 两人感到迫切需要谋生。

sentences.en: They were too naive to understand the necessity of studying.
sentences.zh: 他们太天真了，不懂得学习的重要性。

sentences.en: She did without necessities to pay for her daughter's lessons.
sentences.zh: 为了给女儿上课，她省去了必需品的开支。

senses.zh: 必要(性); (迫切)需要 - 必需品 - 自然规律
